system.description:
MYRATHI

You have grown accustomed to the strange place where decomposition, memory and spirit meet.
You gain Spirit Sense as a tertiary sense with a range of 15 feet. When you use Search, you can detect the presence and general direction of disembodied spirits, incorporeal undead, haunts and active possession within this range.
If you already possess Spirit Sense from another source, increase its range by 15 feet instead.
Furthermore, you gain a +1-racial bonus to Recall Knowledge checks concerning spirits, souls, burial practices and the Ancestral Bloom.

Prerequisites Morrai growth, Gravecap Resonance, Level 5

Works automatically: Spirit Sense (15 ft, tertiary) is on your senses list — if you already have one, note the +15 ft by hand; +1 racial to Recall Knowledge is offered with the book's wording.
